item.title: UX-10 : formulaire du questionnaire UX (#634)
item.body:
## Issue
Closes #634
Claim: mac/ux10-build
LOT-

## What and why

Builds the UX survey form in `tooling/ux-survey/` exactly as `docs/ux/questionnaire/formulaire-spec.md` describes (Go standard library + `modernc.org/sqlite`, no-build front, Docker Compose, Tailscale Funnel per #706): content transcribed from `questions.md` with a concordance test, server-side validation and conditions, token/IP/rate-limit/honeypot anti-abuse, end screen after 10 answers, headers/CSP/logs without IP, exports (`analyse`, `agregats`, `pseudos`), idempotent closing and erasure, rights commands, data notice page from `donnees.md`. Visuals of #632 do not exist: clearly marked placeholders at the names of `cadrage-construction.md` §3.3 (see README). Adds `.github/workflows/ux-survey.yml` (go vet, go test, node --test, path-filtered).

Not merged, nothing deployed.

## How it was verified

- `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` green: tests 1–23 of spec §14 (concordance with `questions.md` checked by mutation, content, conditions, validation, storage, token/IP duplicates, proxy, honeypot, rate limit, origin, stats, closing, exports, erasure incl. resume after a busy checkpoint, rights, config, headers, logs, weight/CSP, restricted access).
- `node --test web/logique.test.mjs`: 9/9 (conditions, G1 order, shuffle, D1, envoi, comparison).
- `markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1`: 0 errors on added Markdown.
- Local walkthrough in the browser: iPhone path (10 steps, D1/D2 hidden) and iPad path (12 steps, D1 sort with Monter/Descendre, "comme aujourd'hui" toggle, D2 visuals), send, draft erased, end screen with comparison at 12 answers.
- Not done: the Docker image was not built (Docker daemon down; `docker compose config` valid); the new CI workflow has not run yet.

## Open points (choices to confirm in the Opus review)

PO decisions of 2026-11-11 are applied (see the last commit): R13 "limited" response and R5 closing date never moved later (both added to the spec: §5.3, §8, §10, §12, §14 tests 24–25, §15), `golang.org/x/text` for NFC (pinned `v0.28.0`; now the second third-party dependency, noted in spec §1 and README), and `I1` showing only the short help and link of `questions.md`.

1. **Test 22 vs `donnees.md`**: the page contains `https://www.cnil.fr`; the test allows that one `<a href>` (never a resource).
2. **Visuals**: file names and alt texts are mine; `docs/ux/questionnaire/visuels/` is created for test 2 (probable add/add conflict with #632); `.mp4` are empty containers (no encoder), the poster is shown.
3. **Stats cache** is invalidated after an accepted send (else the 10th respondent would not see results); otherwise 1 minute.
4. `fermer`/`effacer` refuse before `UX_FERMETURE`; `export --sortie` is a prefix (date and extension appended); invalid `Content-Type` gives 400 (not 415) to stay within the §7 table.
5. `UX_EN_TETE_CLIENT` not added (Funnel header check is spec §13); no HEALTHCHECK (distroless, no curl); IP fingerprint on the full address (no IPv6 /64); the Docker image was not built (daemon down, `docker compose config` valid).
6. Drag and drop for `D1` (optional) not done.

## Checklist (AGENTS.md §9)
- [x] Module boundaries respected (no sibling imports in HFRKit, no UI framework in HFRKit): no Swift touched
- [x] Tests added/updated — differential tests for ported logic: N/A (not a port), spec §14 tests added
- [x] No secrets; fixtures anonymized
- [x] Docs updated (README of the tool, provisional visuals inventory); after the merge, #634 is closed by hand with `Done in #PR (merged as <sha>)`
- [x] Author model: Sonnet 5.5 / Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (requested, not done by the author)
- [ ] Ledger: not applicable (no legacy behaviour change)

comments.body: Review requested: Opus 5.5 (author: Sonnet 5.5). Then the security and privacy review #635.

PO decisions of 2026-11-11 applied in 1caa5827:
1. **R13 / R5**: `pseudo --limiter <id>` / `--lever-limite <id>` (column `limitee`, excluded from stats, `agregats.json` and every export, still found by `--chercher`); `UX_FERMETURE` stored in a `meta` table at the first answer, can be moved earlier, never later (service and commands refuse to start otherwise). Spec updated (§5.3, §8, §10, §12, §14 tests 24–25, §15 R13) and tests added.
2. **NFC**: `golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm`, pinned v0.28.0, in-house composer removed; README and spec §1 updated.
3. **I1**: only the short help and the link of `questions.md`; the `donnees.md` §1 paragraph is gone from that screen (spec §3, §4, §10 adjusted).
Full tests green (go vet, go test, node --test 9/9), markdownlint 0 errors. Other open points left for the Opus review.

Merged `origin/dev-swift` into the branch (merge commit, no rebase, no force-push). One conflict, in `docs/ux/questionnaire/formulaire-spec.md` line 17 (the D4 paragraph): dev-swift (#706) rewrote the exposure sentence for Tailscale Funnel, my branch had changed "R1 à R12" to "R1 à R13". Resolved by keeping dev-swift's Funnel wording and my "R1 à R13". Everything else merged cleanly (fixtures corpus split, docs touches elsewhere). Re-ran go vet, go test (all packages), node --test (9/9) and markdownlint (0 errors) after the merge: green.

## Réponse à la revue Opus (head `a45d3102`) Tests : `go vet`, `go test -race -count=1 ./...` (tous les paquets, y compris le nouveau `cmd/ux-survey`), `node --test` 10/10, markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1 : 0 erreur. Rien n'est fusionné ni déployé. **1. D2, vidéos.** Corrigé : la case et son libellé sont dans `.option .choix` (seule zone positionnée) ; détails et visuels sont hors de cette zone. Vérifié dans le navigateur à 800 px : `elementFromPoint` au centre de chaque `

reviews.body:
## Opus review of #712 (UX-10 survey form) **Verdict: ready after minor fixes.** One user-visible front bug has to be fixed before the five-person test (finding 1). The rest are small fixes, test tightening and dead-code removal. The backend follows the spec closely: flow, validation, anti-abuse, closing, erasure, R5 and R13 are all implemented as written, and the code is easy to read. Reviewed head `949043c3` in a separate worktree. Nothing deployed, no external service contacted. ### Test results - `go vet ./...`: clean. `go test -count=1 ./...`: all packages pass. `go test -race -count=1 ./...`: pass. That is 46 Go tests plus 9/9 for `node --test web/logique.test.mjs` (Node 22.19, Go 1.27.3). - Mutation checks on `questions.md`, to confirm the concordance test is not a tautology. Each mutation **failed the test as it should**: a D1 state label, an L1 detail, the L2 limit (280 to 300), the D2 condition (dropping `plusieurs`) and a C02/C03 swap. **One mutation slipped through**: changing the `I1` link text (« Vos données : ce qui est gardé et pourquoi ») inside the I1 block only. The test only fails when the copy in E0 is changed too. - `donnees.html` against `donnees.md` §2, compared word by word: they match (ratio 0.984, and every difference is punctuation spacing or the page chrome). - Hands-on run of the binary (`aucun` proxy, loopback): POST 201, duplicate token gives 409, R5 refuses a later `UX_FERMETURE` on every command, `pseudo --chercher ' TOTO'` finds both rows, `effacer` is refused before closing, and `export analyse` writes 0600 files with the expected columns. Files in the data directory are 0600 and the directory 0700. The log has no client IP. - Read-only-root concern ruled out: I ran `Fermeture` (VACUUM plus the TRUNCATE checkpoint) under a macOS sandbox that denies writes to every temp directory and to the cwd. It passes, because SQLite keeps the small VACUUM temp database in memory. No `tmpfs` is needed for a database this size. - Not run here: the Docker image (no cached base images, and pulling them was outside this review's scope), and the new CI workflow. ### Findings, by severity **1. D2 videos cannot be played by click or tap (major, front).** `web/style.css:56` stretches the invisible radio input over the whole `.option` (`position:absolute; inset:0; width/height:100%`). `app.js:216-222` puts the details `
